job.title: Administration Assistant - Executive Services
job.description:
The successful candidate assists the Executive Assistant to provide efficient and confidential administrative support to the Chief Executive Officer, the Mayor and Elected Members.

Working 48 hours per fortnight you will be able to negotiate the days you work.

If you have previously assisted the CEO, Mayor and Elected Members with their requests and administrative needs, conference and travel arrangements, training and registration of correspondence then we would like to hear from you.

Previous relevant experience in a similar role will be highly regarded.

Interested candidates must be able to meet the essential criteria in the position description.

Please call Sharon Dockery on (08) 9323 8817 for more information and to obtain the selection criteria. You can also register your interest for other administrative positions, full time, part-time and permanent with Sharon.

job.title: Boilermaker
job.description:
At CoreStaff we pride ourselves on looking after our employees. We want to engage, reward and recognise you for doing a great job. Feel like part of the Crew, not just another candidate sent to an assignment and forgotten about.

Our client, a leading manufacturer in both Steel and galvanizing industries are seeking an experienced Boilermaker to join their team.

This role is based in Port Kembla and will see you working on an ongoing casual basis Monday to Friday on day shift commencing at 6am with overtime available.

The hourly rate will be $45 per hour + penalties and for the right candidate this may lead to a permanent role.
Your duties will include but are not limited to:
  • Mig welding
  • Stick Welding
  • General duties
To be successful for this role, you will need to have:
  • Previous Boilermaker experience
  • Previous with structural steel is preferred
  • Previous experience in MIG and Stick Welding
  • Availability to work Monday to Friday, day shift
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings
  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal
CoreStaff is a leader in workplace diversity, and we encourage applications from Indigenous Australians for all roles, females for non-traditional female roles, and applicants with disabilities to apply for all our jobs.

If you believe you have met the above criteria, then please forward your resume by clicking the “Apply Now” button or alternatively call our office on (02) 8881-0901.
